newsitem.title: INDIA: India HLL shr falls after results.
newsitem.headline: India HLL shr falls after results.

text.p: The share of Hindustan Lever Ltd (HLL) on Friday fell after the firm announced lower than expected profits for calendar 1996, brokers said.
"The quality of earnings is not very good in line with that of previous year," Govind Agarwal, a dealer at brokerage Motilal Oswal.
"We had been expecting a net profit of 4.7 billion rupees."
HLL said its latest results included those of Brooke Bond Lipton India which was merged with it effective January 1, 1996.

Net profit and sales of the combined firm totalled 4.14 billion rupees and 66.00 billion, respectively. In 1995, profits and sales of HLL alone were 2.39 billion rupees and 33.67 billion, respectively.
At 0900 GMT, the HLL share was down 8.0 rupees at 1000.5 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
